title: Binance Ai Pro: Major Update — Your AI Trading Assistant Just Got Smarter
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce a significant upgrade to Binance Ai Pro, making your AI-powered trading assistant smarter, more personalized, and more powerful than ever. We're rolling out five innovative features designed to enhance your trading strategy and user experience. What's New in Binance Ai Pro: Professional Strategy Templates:  Access more comprehensive trading signals and more precise asset selection. No coding knowledge is required — AI Pro helps you create quantitative trading strategies with ease. Advanced Document Analysis:  Upload research notes, trading strategies, or other documents in Markdown or TXT format. AI Pro can read, summarize, and analyze them directly within the conversation, helping you quickly turn external strategies into referenceable and actionable trading ideas. Flexible AI Model Switching:  Choose different AI engines based on the task. Lightweight models are suitable for quick market checks and basic questions, while more powerful models are designed for complex analysis, strategy simulation, and advanced trading scenarios — ensuring each task is matched with the right level of AI capability. Enhanced AI Trading Skills:  Quantitative backtesting is now more accurate and responsive. Combined with real-time market data collection capabilities, AI Pro provides more comprehensive support for trading analysis, strategy validation, and active decision-making. Agentic Wallet Integrates Prediction Markets:  Supports event browsing, probability analysis, and autonomous participation. AI Pro can assist you throughout the process — helping you understand market information, assess event probabilities, and complete the subsequent decision-making flow. Start Your Ai Pro Now Notes:  Leftover credits will  not  roll over to the next month. Users will start each month with  5 million usage credits  once the new billing cycle begins for that month.  Security and Risk Notice Binance Ai Pro strictly limits AI API key permissions to ensure the AI Account operates only within authorized scopes, mitigating risks that might arise from having excessive access. In addition, users’ master account and AI Account are isolated for independent management to enhance security. Please note that AI trading is automated; Binance does not control specific AI trading actions; Binance does not provide any strategies or advice and assumes no responsibility for outcomes resulting from AI trades. AI-assisted trading carries inherent risks, please use AI products responsibly and make informed decisions. Future Developments  Binance highly values and welcomes your  feedback  to help us improve our AI products. Going forward, we plan to allow users to manually purchase additional advanced credits during the usage cycle that would provide greater flexibility in interacting with the advanced model, continuously enrich and add new Binance Skills, and permit user customization of certain third party AI skills, further enhancing the intelligence and personalization of Binance Ai Pro.
